topic: 多項式因式分解：以動畫展示如何將三次多項式分解成線性因式的步驟。
topic_en: Polynomial Factorization: Animating the steps to factor a cubic polynomial into linear factors.
description: Visual representation of the factorization process of a cubic polynomial. The animation should illustrate each step, starting from finding potential roots to completing the factorization.

topic: 勾股定理證明：利用動態幾何展示和直角三角形相關的三個不同證明。
topic_en: Pythagorean Theorem Proofs: Using dynamic geometry to show three different proofs related to right triangles.
description: The animation explains three unique demonstrations of the Pythagorean theorem, involving squares on the sides, geometric rearrangements, and algebraic methods.

topic: 三角函數的單位圓：動態呈現三角函數如何在單位圓上運作。
topic_en: Unit Circle and Trigonometric Functions: Dynamically showing how trigonometric functions operate on the unit circle.
description: A visual journey around the unit circle, illustrating the connection between the circle and sine, cosine, and tangent, including special angles and their respective coordinates.

topic: 等比級數應用：使用動畫演示如何計算無限等比級數的收斂值。
topic_en: Geometric Series Application: Using animation to demonstrate how to calculate the convergence of an infinite geometric series.
description: The animation provides an intuitive approach to understanding the concept of convergence in a geometric series through a step-by-step breakdown, gently transitioning into the formula derivation.

topic: 向量加法和幾何解釋：以動畫展示向量在平面上的加法如何達成。
topic_en: Vector Addition and Geometric Interpretation: Animating how vector addition is achieved on a plane.
description: A visual demonstration of the vector addition process, illustrating both the parallelogram method and the tip-to-tail method, allowing students to see how vectors combine geometrically.

topic: 間中比例作為理解20:4和比例分解的入門途徑
topic_en: The Mean Proportional as an Introduction to 20:4 and Proportional Decomposition
description: Visualizing how the mean proportional is applied through unique graphics breaking up 20:4 in interactive segments

topic: 動畫展示正負數多項式的展開和結合
topic_en: Animated Exploration of Expansion and Combination of Positive and Negative Polynomials
description: Using distinct colors to show how expanding and combining polynomials interact across positive and negative terms

topic: 探索二次方程的根和圖形表示
topic_en: Exploration of Roots and Graphical Representation of Quadratic Equations
description: An animation showing dynamic changes in a graph based on the variance of roots in quadratic equations, with an emphasis on symmetry and vertex shifts

topic: 動畫詮釋正弦函數的周期性
topic_en: Animation Interpretation of the Periodicity of the Sine Function
description: Illustrating how shifting angles visually transform sine curves over periods, reinforcing periodicity and frequency concepts with wave animation

topic: 解釋等腰三角形中等分線的特殊性質
topic_en: Explaining the Special Properties of Medians in Isosceles Triangles
description: Demonstrating the median drawings in an isosceles triangle with a focus on bisecting angles and their congruent segments using symmetry patterns

topic: 在坐標平面中，動畫展示不同類型二次方程的拋物線圖像
topic_en: Animated visualization of parabolas in the coordinate plane for various types of quadratic equations
description: Showcase how changes in coefficients of quadratic equations affect the shape and position of parabolas on the coordinate plane.

topic: 通過動畫視覺化不同三角函數的周期和振幅變化
topic_en: Visualizing the changes in period and amplitude of different trigonometric functions
description: Animate how altering the period and amplitude parameters of sine and cosine functions affects their graphs.

topic: 利用動畫解釋圓內接四邊形的對角互補性質
topic_en: Animated explanation of the cyclic quadrilateral property of opposite angles summing to 180 degrees
description: Illustrate the property of opposite angles in a cyclic quadrilateral and how they are complementary.

topic: 用動畫展示如何從二次方程提取和圖像中的對稱軸和頂點坐標
topic_en: Animation showing how to derive the axis of symmetry and vertex coordinates from a quadratic equation and graph
description: Graphical interpretation of quadratic formula results to find the axis of symmetry and vertex coordinates.

topic: 以動畫形式演示等差數列的視覺表達及其累加求和
topic_en: Animated demonstration of the visual representation and summation of an arithmetic sequence
description: Progressively animate the addition of terms in an arithmetic sequence, visualizing its sum formula.

topic: 用動畫展示二次函數的頂點形式及拋物線的移動
topic_en: Visualize the vertex form of a quadratic function and the translation of the parabola
description: The animation will show the conversion of a standard quadratic equation to its vertex form, followed by dynamic movements translating the parabola up, down, left, and right on the coordinate plane.

topic: 動畫演示勾股定理及斜邊長的計算
topic_en: Animated demonstration of the Pythagorean theorem and calculation of the hypotenuse length
description: The animation will depict a right triangle, show the square of the two legs built on their sides, and calculate the hypotenuse using Pythagorean theorem, transitioning from the geometrical squares on each side.

topic: 通過動畫理解三角函數的單位圓概念
topic_en: Understanding the concept of trigonometric functions with the unit circle through animation
description: Illustrate the unit circle, while rotating an angle to show how sine, cosine, and tangent values are extracted from the circle, animating the dynamic projection on a coordinate system.

topic: 探索解析幾何中直線方程的斜率和截距
topic_en: Explore the slope and intercept of a line equation in analytic geometry
description: The animation will graphically demonstrate different line equations, adjusting their slopes and intercepts interactively to showcase how the equation of a line changes on a graph grid.

topic: 用動畫展現排列組合中的背對背抽象計數法
topic_en: Exhibit the abstract counting method in permutations and combinations through animation
description: Visual animations will guide the realization of real-world scenarios turned into permutation and combination counting, showing step-by-step how combinatorial calculations are set up and solved.

topic: 動畫會示範如何求 8x^2 - 12x + 4 的頂點表示法
topic_en: Animation illustrating how to convert 8x^2 - 12x + 4 into vertex form
description: The animation will demonstrate completing the square to convert a quadratic expression from standard form to vertex form.

topic: 連續動畫展示圓的切線是正交於半徑的定義證明
topic_en: Sequential animation showing the theorem proof that tangent to a circle is perpendicular to its radius
description: The animation will visualize a circle, a tangent line, and how drawing the radius to the tangent point meets the line at a right angle, illustrating this geometric theorem.

topic: 用動畫展示始終不變的對數規律 log(ab) = log(a) + log(b)
topic_en: Animation depicting the constant logarithm rule log(ab) = log(a) + log(b)
description: The animation visually explores the logarithm product rule by transforming logarithmic expressions using properties and illustrating how they combine.

topic: 使用動畫解析 y=ax^2+bx+c 程序中二次函數拋物線轉移
topic_en: Utilizing animation to analyze the translation of a quadratic function parabola y=ax^2+bx+c
description: The animation will present how variations in the coefficients a, b, and c translate and reshape the parabola graphically on a coordinate plane.

topic: 通過動畫展示添加條件卡方不等式的直接應用
topic_en: Demonstrate the direct application of Chebyshev's inequality through animation
description: An educational visualization into undescribed concepts with a high-level perspective introducing numerical spread using Chebyshev's inequality for probability predictions.

topic: 用坐標圖探討一次函數 y = 2x + 3
topic_en: Explore the linear function y = 2x + 3 using a coordinate graph
description: Visualize how the linear function y = 2x + 3 is graphed on a coordinate plane, highlighting the slope and intercept.

topic: 透過動畫展示平方根的近似計算
topic_en: Demonstrate approximations of square roots using animation
description: Showcase the method of finding approximate square roots visually through iterative refinement on the number line.

topic: 以動畫形式揭示三角形內角和的定理
topic_en: Reveal the Triangle Sum Theorem using an animation
description: Animate cutting and rearranging angles of a triangle to demonstrate that the sum of its internal angles is 180 degrees.

topic: 呈現多邊形的內部角度總和與邊數的關係
topic_en: Present the relationship between the internal angles sum and the number of sides of a polygon
description: Visually derive the formula for the sum of internal angles in a polygon as (n-2)*180 degrees.

topic: 藉由平面與圓柱的介面切割展示圓錐曲線
topic_en: Demonstrate conic sections with interactions between a plane and a cylinder
description: Animate how different cuts through a vertical cylinder reveal various conic sections: circles, ellipses, parabolas, and hyperbolas.

topic: 動畫展示一條漸近線如何影響雙曲線的繪製
topic_en: Animated demonstration of how an asymptote affects the graphing of a hyperbola
description: Visualize a hyperbola approaching its asymptotes as x and y grow, showing how the curves approach without crossing the asymptotes.

topic: 使用坐標幾何法求直線與圓的交點
topic_en: Finding intersection points of a line and a circle using coordinate geometry
description: Graphically depict the intersection points of a given circle and line on the Cartesian plane, solving equations to find exact coordinates.

topic: 説明如何通過變化三角形邊長來影響餘弦定理的計算
topic_en: Explanation of how varying triangle side lengths affects calculation of the cosine rule
description: Animate a triangle's side length changes and show real-time updates to the cosine rule calculations, demonstrating dependence on side lengths and angles.

topic: 直觀演示帕斯卡三角之循環對稱性質
topic_en: Visually demonstrating the cyclic symmetry properties of Pascal’s Triangle
description: Create an animation emphasizing cyclic patterns observed within Pascal's Triangle, showing symmetrical patterns re-surface across different rows.

topic: 利用動畫展示容斥原理如何从兩個圓的交集中計算聯集
topic_en: Using animation to demonstrate how the principle of inclusion-exclusion calculates the union from the intersection of two circles
description: Show two overlapping circles and gradually animate the calculation of individual, intersecting, and union areas using inclusion-exclusion principles.

topic: 畫出雙曲線 y = 1/x 並展示其漸近線和對稱性質
topic_en: Graph the hyperbola y = 1/x and illustrate its asymptotes and symmetry properties
description: Visualize the hyperbola y = 1/x on a coordinate plane, showing its shape, how it approaches both horizontal and vertical asymptotes, and explore its symmetry about the line y = x and the origin.

topic: 用向量求簡單多邊形的面積
topic_en: Use vectors to find the area of a simple polygon
description: Animate how vectors can be used to calculate the area of a given polygon by decomposing it into triangles and using vector cross products to determine each area.

topic: 演示等腰三角形的性質，包括其高、內切圓和外接圓
topic_en: Demonstrate the properties of an isosceles triangle, including its height, incircle, and circumcircle
description: Animate an isosceles triangle to explore and label its congruent sides, height, inscribed circle, and circumscribed circle, showing geometric constructions and central relationships.

topic: 解釋正弦定理和餘弦定理在任何三角形中的應用
topic_en: Explain the application of the Law of Sines and Cosines in any triangle
description: Visualize how the Law of Sines and the Law of Cosines can be applied to various types of triangles to find unknown sides and angles, using step-by-step geometric visualization.

topic: 揭 示二次函數的拋物線凹凸性的變化過程，並考慮其頂點
topic_en: Reveal the changing concavity of a parabola in a quadratic function and consider its vertex
description: Animate the graph of a quadratic function to show how the concavity of the parabola changes and focus on the movement and position of its vertex as coefficients in the quadratic expression are varied.

topic: 通過結構化動畫演示證明均值不等式
topic_en: Visually proving the AM-GM inequality using structured animations
description: Animate and explain why the arithmetic mean is always greater than or equal to the geometric mean for two numbers using geometric shapes and transformations.

topic: 通過旋轉動畫展示複數的模和幅角
topic_en: Displaying modulus and argument of complex numbers through rotation animations
description: Animate the transition of a complex number on the Argand plane while highlighting how the modulus and argument change as it rotates around the origin.

topic: 用動畫揭示三角形外接圓心的構建
topic_en: Unveiling the construction of a triangle's circumcenter with animation
description: Show the perpendicular bisectors of a triangle meeting at a single point, the circumcenter, using animated steps and bisector tracing.

topic: 用動畫解釋拋物線的頂點和焦點之間的關係
topic_en: Explaining the relationship between the vertex and focus of a parabola using animations
description: Visually demonstrate how the directrix, focus, and vertex of a parabola are related by illustrating distances maintained for a moving line reflecting signals.

topic: 利用動畫展示雙曲線的漸近線
topic_en: Demonstrating the asymptotes of a hyperbola through animation
description: Portray a hyperbola graphically approaching its asymptotes through smooth transition animations to showcase their relationship and significance.

topic: 動畫展示時鐘指針如何表示整點和半點
topic_en: Animate clock hands to show how they represent whole hours and half hours
description: Show a clock face where the hour and minute hands move to demonstrate reading time at whole hours and half hours

topic: 用積木動畫說明長方體的長寬高與體積計算
topic_en: Use block animation to explain length, width, height of a rectangular prism and volume calculation
description: Animate stacking unit cubes to fill a rectangular prism, showing how volume equals length times width times height

topic: 動畫演示兩位數加法的進位過程
topic_en: Animate the carrying process in two-digit addition
description: Visually show how digits carry over from the ones column to the tens column when adding two two-digit numbers
